sources.sql:
CREATE TABLE "budget" (
  "budget_id" TEXT,
  "category" TEXT,
  "spent" REAL,
  "remaining" REAL,
  "amount" INTEGER,
  "event_status" TEXT,
  "link_to_event" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE "event" (
  "event_id" TEXT,
  "event_name" TEXT,
  "event_date" TEXT,
  "type" TEXT,
  "notes" TEXT,
  "location" TEXT,
  "status" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE "expense" (
  "expense_id" TEXT,
  "expense_description" TEXT,
  "expense_date" TEXT,
  "cost" REAL,
  "approved" TEXT,
  "link_to_member" TEXT,
  "link_to_budget" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE "income" (
  "income_id" TEXT,
  "date_received" TEXT,
  "amount" INTEGER,
  "source" TEXT,
  "notes" TEXT,
  "link_to_member" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE "Personal_Info" (
  "member_id" TEXT,
  "first_name" TEXT,
  "last_name" TEXT,
  "email" TEXT,
  "phone" TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE "zip_code" (
  "zip_code" INTEGER,
  "type" TEXT,
  "city" TEXT,
  "county" TEXT,
  "state" TEXT,
  "short_state" TEXT
);
